decisions.reason: Because Product C remained on its own page across 2023 and 2024 and builds directly on the firm’s established postpress portfolio, its observed performance likely meets aspiration levels well enough that a German machinery wholesaler with a broad range and no visible distress would keep it.

Because Product F is close to the core offer, stayed on the website in 2024, and is backed by a concrete customer-use result showing integrated value in one-pass finishing, management would likely judge it above or near aspiration and keep it while using available slack to support further market diffusion.
